intent: Make the standalone PFC power-entry interfaces and current evidence machine-checkable, preserve explicit indeterminate status where physics or external producers are absent, and prevent coverage hooks from being removed silently.

findings.title: PFC waveform ignores the documented PF 0.99 input bound
findings.suggested_fix: Represent PF in the waveform configuration or align the source-bound model and power-entry nominal screen; add a regression that the 15 A, PF 0.99 case produces 1782 W before losses.
findings.first_evidence: input_power_w is calculated as line_rms_v * fundamental_rms while the power-entry contract documents 120 V * 15 A * 0.99 = 1782 W.
findings.why_it_matters: The PFC branch and shunt stress are driven from this power, so the model can accept an inconsistent ~1800 W condition while the interface contract limits nominal input to 1782 W.
findings.evidence: pfc_power::run consumes waveform.input_power_w/load_a; power_entry::nominal_screen applies PF 0.99 independently.

findings.title: Manufacturing geometry receipt is not cryptographically bound
findings.suggested_fix: Bind the manufacturing receipt's canonical/hash fields and extractor/native census to the reviewed artifact, and add a mutation test showing edited polygons are rejected even when board hash and UUIDs remain unchanged.
findings.first_evidence: The new check only requires nonempty, unique pad IDs; receipt polygons are then consumed by build_with_manufacturing without a receipt hash check.
findings.why_it_matters: An edited pad polygon can change contact chords and produce false geometry evidence while retaining the same board hash and physical IDs.
findings.evidence: pfc_power::run validates board_sha256 but not extractor_sha256/full receipt identity before using inner_copper_polygons and drill_polygon.

findings.title: Return continuity remains net-wide instead of endpoint-restricted
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve current and return endpoints to physical native nodes and require connectivity along the requested endpoint path; add a mutation test removing q_boost.3 while leaving a remote return-net trace.
findings.first_evidence: The validator checks net/cluster membership and existence of any return trace, but does not prove path.return_endpoint is physically connected to the current endpoint subgraph.
findings.why_it_matters: A remote trace on the same return net can satisfy the continuity screen while the required gate or commutation return is absent.
findings.evidence: switching::validate uses return-net presence and any return trace; p3::switching_input maps endpoints to net names only.

findings.title: New PFC tests do not prove complete identity and stress binding
findings.suggested_fix: Assert the exact expected via UUID set and mapped envelopes, peak current and peak I²R, nonzero pad demand/completeness, and malformed shunt/pad/via cases; add a real runner integration assertion.
findings.first_evidence: The test checks only that via_paths is nonempty and IDs are nonempty, plus mean shunt dissipation.
findings.why_it_matters: Omitted vias, incorrect envelope assignment, peak-current regressions, and disconnected pads can pass the current assertions.
findings.evidence: No test currently asserts one-to-one via census, branch_id/current values, peak dissipation, or all modeled endpoint contacts.

findings.title: Interface and P3 mapping regressions are incomplete
findings.suggested_fix: Add per-pin mutation cases, output midpoint/cardinality coverage, exact object/rule assertions, and a direct power-entry P3 endpoint/return mapping test with finding cardinality.
findings.first_evidence: Tests assert the first finding and aggregate indeterminate count, while power-entry P3 endpoint mapping is not directly exercised.
findings.why_it_matters: A wrong individual return or extra midpoint, or a duplicate loop finding, could remain unnoticed while aggregate status still looks expected.
findings.evidence: pfc_interfaces tests do not isolate all eleven pins; p3 tests primarily cover gate-drive paths.

findings.title: Interface contract is not tied to native connector pad identity
findings.suggested_fix: Add an endpoint-to-component/pad/native UUID evidence record and validate it alongside source labels and native graph equality, or explicitly narrow the interface documentation to source-level semantics.
findings.first_evidence: validate(source) checks only source endpoint labels; native connector identity is validated separately and is not part of this contract.
findings.why_it_matters: A same-net connector pad swap or stale physical identity can evade the named interface contract even when source labels are correct.
findings.evidence: Architecture review found no single contract tying each reviewed interface endpoint to its native connector pad UUID.

residual_risks: Via and pad capacity, isolation evidence, bus envelope, supervisor producers, and switching parasitic models remain intentionally indeterminate.
Full hardware and fabrication qualification remain unrun.
testing_gaps: No end-to-end runner fixture proving malformed manufacturing evidence propagates through UnitRunReport.
No direct endpoint-restricted P3 return regression.

coverage.cross_model_review: unavailable; external private-repository route was rejected, local Luna reviewers used
coverage.validation: root reports 446 tests passed and common maintained run preserved expected findings
